title: Signal: Conan lock on an older format
scope: A conan.lock file that declares a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format.
limitations: It matches a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format in the parsed conan.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A conan.lock that mentions a lock `version` from the pre-0.5 format in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
